Container.Name: mcp-boardgametracker
Container.Overview: Board game tracker web app for tracking matches, players, results, and analytics. Features include match entry, average finishing positions, head-to-head comparisons, Monopoly tournament tracking, win odds, trend charts, and versioned game instructions with house rules support.

Config.Name: Data Path
Config.Description: Path on the host where the SQLite database will be stored. All match data, players, and analytics are persisted here.
